Governor's ruling, verbatim intent: an exact-shape assertion changing when the shape changes is the assertion working — that objection has wrongly blocked rows on this board twice.
3. apps/control-room/src/live/live-goal-catalog.ts — CatalogGoal (:24-27) carries three fields and exactDataRecord (:86, length+membership check at :94-96) REJECTS a fourth key, so the daemon-side change alone breaks the live decoder. Widen the expected-key roster and the interface in the SAME commit — this is a cross-package atomic shape change and must never land half.
4. apps/control-room/src/live/live-goal-catalog.test.ts — its exact-shape arms.
5+6. apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/goal-catalog-model.ts / .test.ts — EDIT-ONLY-IF-RED: the model consumes entry.{goalId, planningRunRef, brief}; a new nullable field reaches it only if it spreads or exact-asserts the entry shape.
